name: Promethium Flamer — furnace shimmer · Art Pass V2
notes:
Existing flamer retained from the earlier approved package. Automatically reduced grid interpretation; small details differ from the reference. Grip/pivot/muzzle are initial estimates requiring rig checks. Preview slot W06 confirmed from repository pixelkit-v2 manifest at ae7247a9b94aeb834342cd40e8aea2eb82308bb8. This does not add firing behaviours.
Revision: weapons-v001. Status: draft. Pixel cleanup and anchor/scale review outstanding. Stored in isolated art/weapon-lab branch.

Weapon-lighting-v001: Orange heat chamber and muzzle vents shimmer with smooth overlapping furnace waves. 40 frames at 20 fps; 2s loop. Anchors, dimensions, body silhouette, scale, trim/guts unchanged. New lamp seats affect 12 body pixels inside the existing silhouette. Existing blue emissive chamber is recoloured to furnace orange. Draft: in-game visibility and exact art approval pending. No geometry, articulated motion, firing trigger or 2x density changes.

Anchor-alignment-v001: calibrated handle grip and muzzle for the enlarged weapon rig. Body and all animation layers unchanged. Runtime scales around the grip; ranged shots use the transformed muzzle. Scale remains 1.2. Pending alignment verification.

Art Pass V2: material-family harmonisation. Eight-step neutral charcoal/gunmetal ramp derived from the generated V2 material reference. Original pixel geometry, alpha, markers, scale, dimensions, fps, frame count, emissive PNGs, trim and guts are unchanged. Every frame uses the same RGB material mapping. Existing cyan, magenta, red and amber light identities and all original loops retained. Source is the current shared build 20261101T094357Z-78228871. Saved draft; renderer comparison only; battle playtest and art approval pending.
